Engine component · enhancement

A fact alone isn’t context. Enhancement makes it complete.

Enhancement is the stage that makes context usable. A reconciled, verified value is correct — but a bare number can’t be defended or acted on. Baltor attaches the citation, the relationships, and any verified external source needed to resolve the question, turning an isolated fact into a connected, cited context object. Pick a fact:

Bare fact → enriched object

Same answer · made complete & defensible

What enhancement attaches

Only verified, sourced additions — never invented
⛓
Citations
The exact clause, section or list entry the value resolves to — so any answer can be defended to a regulator or auditor.
⬡
Relationships
Links to related objects — the chapter notes that govern a code, the program behind a sanctions entry, the lane behind an SLA.
⊕
Verified external sources
When internal sources can’t settle it, an approved external authority is attached to complete the context — sourced, not guessed.
Enhancement beside the rest. Enrichment only ever adds sourced material — citations, relationships and verified external context — it never invents a fact to fill a gap. The enriched object is then optimized to the task budget and verified before serving. See the engine overview for all five stages and the receipts explorer for how the attached citations become provenance. Not legal, medical, or financial advice — the source in force is the authority.
